text: Android: self-hosted TLS reality — indistinct error messages, self-signed certs unsupported

relates: T-46 — complementary solutions to the same self-signed-dev-cert
problem. T-46 is a debug-only trust-ALL bypass flag (quick dev path, forced off
in release); this ticket's networkSecurityConfig trusting user-installed CAs is
the "proper" self-host path that also works in release. Whoever picks up either
should know the other exists; ideally the distinct SSLException message here
points the user at both options (install your CA, or flip the dev flag).
